source_request: Add your task to terminals tasks and then proceed to complete it

task.objective: Complete all 210 previously partial original-function-to-MAP/MUTATE rewrites by tracing the pinned codebase, dependencies and primary documentation; update the paired projection with fully explained behavior rather than treating unanalyzed calls as undefined.

scope.prior379: preserve without attributing their work to this agent
scope.source_revisions: retain pinned original source; no substitution with current HEAD

MAP.semantics: compute result without observable state mutation

MUTATE.semantics: apply specified new state to the identified context or external target

requirements: Trace referenced source functions and callbacks instead of marking them unresolved at the call site.
Use implementation and official dependency documentation to resolve host/library behavior.
Preserve argument, receiver, closure, alias, evaluation-order, control-flow, exception, async and return semantics.
Treat variable inputs as conditional behavior, not unknown semantics.
Report actual coding errors specifically; do not label incomplete analysis as undefined behavior.
No opaque original-function wrapper or unsupported extra action vocabulary presented as a completed canonical rewrite.
Validate every function identity and pairing; distinguish semantic verification from structural checks.

ordered_tasks.action: Retrieve pinned source and call/dependency closure with source hashes and resolve documented primitive contracts.
Complete MAP/MUTATE rewrites per function and record source-backed resolutions to the prior questions.
Run meaningful equivalence/contract tests, verify all 210 results and refresh the original/canonical projection.
Verify remote bytes and commit the completed task with evidence, or record precise remaining work without claiming completion.

prohibited: source repository/runtime/workflow mutations outside the authorized analysis workspace
